notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.5.8: changes Garage tabs to Bike, Helmet, Gear, Boots, Goggles, Gloves and Protection, keeps every selector as a real dropdown linked directly to the native MX Bikes profile, and adds an in-app rider-equipment viewer based only on PiBoSo's official MX Bikes rider template geometry from the official templates package. The official template is downloaded/cached lazily when a rider-equipment tab is first opened, parsed inside Race Day Live, and focused on the relevant rider region; no generic humanoid and no MX Bikes process are used. Bike preview uses exact readable source geometry only when supplied by the selected bike. Garage no longer flushes its content cache every time it opens. v0.5.7 PKZ/OEM category linking, v0.5.6 working taskbar icon, v0.5.4 two-way game/profile integration and stay-open hot updates are preserved.
